subject: pri-af-td
title: PRI.AF.TD. ------ TR.
description: Diagram in CMOA(I)-13 (Creative Music Outside of America, Level One — Britain/Germany/Holland), second of two on book p219, paired with v2-p219-1. Continues the European creativity argument by holding affinity-tendency at the principle level against transformation. (C)PRI-AF-TD (the concept of principle affinity-tendency) is crossed with TR (transformation): the question is what principle-affinity-tendency produces when crossed with transformation — the (c) prefix marking that principle-affinity-tendency is being held conceptually (the structural design), and the transformation question is whether European creativity constitutes a transformative move. AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and AFI (affinity insight) form the upper-left cluster. COS-D (cosmic dictates) anchors the upper-left margin. TR is the partner at the upper-right. ALT-D (alternative dynamics), (R)TM (reality of time), and ACT (activism) form the central cluster. (R)INT (reality of interior) sits between TR and the lower outputs. SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) hangs on the right output. IST-F (interior-source functionalism) anchors the right margin. APP-RDEF (apparent redefinition) sits below the central axis. FUND-DY (fundamental dynamics) anchors the lower-right. Structural argument: principle-affinity-tendency-as-concept crossed with transformation is mediated by a triple-mediation: alternative-dynamics, reality-of-time, and activism all sit at the central register between subject and partner. The (r) prefix on INT registers that interior must actually obtain for the output cluster (social-reality-dynamics, interior-source-functionalism, fundamental-dynamics) to register transformation. The diagram exposes Braxton's structural diagnostic of what European creativity must achieve: not just multi-information transference (v2-p219-1), but the *transformational* crossing that requires principle-affinity-tendency, alternative-dynamics, time-as-real, and activism to all be live. Apparent-redefinition as marginal output is the warning: without those upstreams, the crossing produces only the appearance of redefinition.
